summary_ja: Tier2資本の基礎項目と調整項目を列挙し、Tier2資本調達手段の適格要件（10項目）および特殊目的会社を通じた算入条件を規定する条文。
summary_en: Enumerates the basic items and adjustment items of Tier 2 Capital, including ten qualifying criteria for Tier 2 Capital instruments and conditions for inclusion of instruments issued through special purpose companies.
